rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 15 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 4 XP for 4 gold (F), +2 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 5 gold a round (2 early in stage 1). Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 5. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5, 3 gold at 6. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 carousel, 2-5 PvP, 2-6 PvP, 2-7 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, augment 3-2, augment 4-2.

40 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 2 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 4 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9. No XP. Income by stage: 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 8 / 9. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild. Picks: Armory 2-1, augment 2-2, Armory 3-1, augment 3-2, Armory 4-1, augment 4-2, Armory 5-1, Armory 6-1.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Digivolution
rules.html:
Three copies of the same form digivolve into the next form: three Rookies make a Champion (★★), three Champions make an Ultimate (★★★). Copies on the bench and board both count. Items carry over (up to 3; extras go to your item bench).

Each form has about 1.8x and 3.2x the HP and AD of the first, and its ability is 1.7x and 3.0x as strong.

A Rookie sells for its cost. A ★★ of cost 1/2/3/4/5 sells for 3/5/8/11/14 gold, a ★★★ for 8/17/26/35/44.

rules.title: Traits
rules.html:
Every Digimon has a family and a role. A trait turns on when enough different Digimon with it are on your board; two copies of the same Digimon count once. Wild Digimon and the bench don't count.

A Crest (Digi-Egg + a component) gives its holder one more trait.

rules.title: Items and recipes
rules.html:
8 stat components plus the Digi-Egg. Drag a component onto a Digimon; a second component combines into one of 36 completed items. Up to 3 items per Digimon. Items never combine on the item bench, which holds 10.

Digi-Egg + component = one of 19 Crests. Two Digi-Eggs make a Golden Digi-Egg (+1 team size). Selling a Digimon returns its items. Magnetic Remover and Reforger take items off or reroll them.

Items come from the 1-1 carousel, the Armory (components through stage 3, completed items after) and loot orbs from wild rounds. Walk your Little Legend into an orb to open it.

rules.title: Combat
rules.html:
Digimon attack on their own and gain 10 mana per attack, plus mana when hit. At full mana they cast their ability. Critical strikes deal 160% damage. After 30 seconds, overtime adds 20% damage every second.

Ability values in the codex assume 100 ability power.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 15 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 4 XP for 4 gold (F), +2 XP each round, up to level 9. Income: 5 gold a round (2 early in stage 1). Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 5. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5, 3 gold at 6. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 carousel, 2-5 PvP, 2-6 PvP, 2-7 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, augment 3-2, augment 4-2.

40 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Partners
rules.html:
From level 4, a shop slot can offer a Partner: a Digimon already in its Champion form (like 3 copies) for 3 times its cost. One of its traits is marked and counts twice, and it gains 200 HP plus one bonus: 300 HP, 40 ability power, 20% attack damage, or 20% lower max mana.

You can own one Partner at a time. While you have one, no more are offered; sell it to see them again. A Partner keeps its bonus when it digivolves. You see at least one Partner by round 2-2.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 2 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 4 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9. No XP. Income by stage: 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 8 / 9. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild. Picks: Armory 2-1, augment 2-2, Armory 3-1, augment 3-2, Armory 4-1, augment 4-2, Armory 5-1, Armory 6-1.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Partners
rules.html:
From level 4, a shop slot can offer a Partner: a Digimon already in its Champion form (like 3 copies) for 3 times its cost. One of its traits is marked and counts twice, and it gains 200 HP plus one bonus: 300 HP, 40 ability power, 20% attack damage, or 20% lower max mana.

You can own one Partner at a time. While you have one, no more are offered; sell it to see them again. A Partner keeps its bonus when it digivolves. You see at least one Partner by round 2-2.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 3 / 4 / 6 / 9 / 13 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 4 XP for 4 gold (F), +2 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 5 gold a round (2 early in stage 1). Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 5. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 2, 2 gold at 4, 3 gold at 5. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 carousel, 2-5 PvP, 2-6 PvP, 2-7 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, augment 3-2, augment 4-2.

40 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Galaxies
rules.html:
TFT Set 3 on Digimon: DigiDestined, Dark Area, DigiXros fusions and Data Pirates. Every game rolls one Galaxy, a rule that changes the game for every Tamer.

Galaxies. Every game rolls one Galaxy from the seed, the same for every Tamer, and shows it at the start of the game. A Galaxy changes the rules for the whole game: extra items, free rerolls, bigger teams, copies of your Digimon and more. File Island and Big Bang are twice as likely as the others.

rules.title: Economy and damage
rules.html:
Standard pace. 8 Tamers start with 100 HP. Buy 4 XP for 4 gold and gain 2 XP a round, up to level 10. Income is 5 gold a round (less in stage 1), plus 1 interest per 10 gold saved (up to 5) and streak gold (2 in a row: 1, 4: 2, 5 or more: 3). A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

A loss costs the Set 3 stage damage (0, 3, 4, 5, 10, 15, 20 in stages 1-7) plus 1 HP per surviving enemy Digimon.

rules.html: Three copies of a form digivolve into the next form. Items: 8 components, 36 completed items, and the Digimental, which makes a Crest with a component or a Golden Digimental (+1 team size) with another Digimental. 10 more Crests have no recipe and come from the Armory and loot.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 1 / 2 / 2 / 3 / 3 / 4 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9. No XP. Income by stage: 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 8 / 9. No interest. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild. Picks: Armory 2-1, augment 2-2, Armory 3-1, augment 3-2, Armory 4-1, augment 4-2, Armory 5-1, Armory 6-1.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.html:

rules.title: Economy and damage
rules.html:
8 Tamers start with 20 HP and 3 gold. Everyone levels up at the start of each stage (level 3 in stage 1, then 4 to 9). Income is set by stage (3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 8, 9 gold). Win or loss streaks of 3 pay 1 extra gold, streaks of 5 pay 2. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

A PvP loss costs 1 HP in stages 1-4, 2 in stages 5-6, 3 in stage 7 and 4 after that. From stage 3, every surviving enemy Digimon at Champion form or above (or of cost 4-5) adds 1 more. A wild round loss costs 1 HP plus the same per surviving wild Digimon.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 15 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 4 XP for 4 gold (F), +2 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 5 gold a round (2 early in stage 1). Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 5. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5, 3 gold at 6. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 carousel, 2-5 PvP, 2-6 PvP, 2-7 wild.

40 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Digivice upgrades and Hextech Gates
rules.html:
At 2-1, 3-2 and 4-2 every Tamer picks 1 of 3 Digivice upgrades (augments), with one reroll. When the game starts, a Hextech Gate pattern decides the tier (Silver, Gold or Prismatic) of all three rounds for the whole lobby. Every upgrade card shows the whole pattern.

A Silver gate also gives every Tamer a random component and 4 gold. A Gold gate gives 2 gold. Clockwork and Chrome Digizoid get stronger for every upgrade you own.

rules.title: Rounds
rules.html: Standard pace: 100 Tamer HP, XP (4 XP for 4 gold), interest and streak gold, 2-gold rerolls. 1-1 carousel, 1-2 to 1-4 wild Digimon; then x-1 to x-3 player combat, x-4 carousel, x-5 and x-6 player combat, x-7 wild Digimon. No Armory. Digivice upgrades at 2-1, 3-2 and 4-2.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 2 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 4 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9. No XP. Income by stage: 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 8 / 9. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild. Picks: Armory 2-3, Armory 3-3, Armory 4-3, Armory 5-3, Armory 6-3.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Digivice upgrades and Hextech Gates
rules.html:
At 2-1, 3-2 and 4-2 every Tamer picks 1 of 3 Digivice upgrades (augments), with one reroll. When the game starts, a Hextech Gate pattern decides the tier (Silver, Gold or Prismatic) of all three rounds for the whole lobby. Every upgrade card shows the whole pattern.

A Silver gate also gives every Tamer a random component and 4 gold. A Gold gate gives 2 gold. Clockwork and Chrome Digizoid get stronger for every upgrade you own.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 15 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 4 XP for 4 gold (F), +2 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 5 gold a round (2 early in stage 1). Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 5. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5, 3 gold at 6. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 carousel, 2-5 PvP, 2-6 PvP, 2-7 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, Armory 2-5, augment 3-2, augment 4-2, Armory 4-5, Armory 5-5.

40 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Shadow items
rules.html: Spore components (from the Armory, wild Digimon loot and the carousels after the first) have the same stats as normal components. A Spore component combined with any component makes the Shadow version of the item: stronger, with a drawback written on the item. A drawback never knocks out its holder. A Digi-Egg plus a Spore component makes one of 8 rarer Crests. The X-Antibody augment halves drawbacks.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 2 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 4 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9. No XP. Income by stage: 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 8 / 9. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild. Picks: Armory 2-1, augment 2-2, augment 3-2, Armory 3-3, augment 4-2, Armory 5-1, Armory 6-1.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Rounds
rules.html:
8 Tamers start with 20 HP. Last one standing wins.

1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild Digimon, 1-3 wild Digimon.

2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild Digimon.

3-1 carousel, 3-2 PvP, 3-3 PvP, 3-4 wild Digimon. The 3-1 carousel is the Shadow carousel: lowest HP picks first, and half its items are Spore components.

Armory at 2-1, Armory at 3-3, Radiant Armory at 4-1, Armory at 5-1, Armory at 6-1. Augments at 2-2, 3-2, 4-2.

rules.title: Shadow items
rules.html: Spore components (from the Armory, wild Digimon loot and the 3-1 carousel) have the same stats as normal components. A Spore component combined with any component makes the Shadow version of the item: stronger, with a drawback written on the item. A drawback never knocks out its holder. A Digi-Egg plus a Spore component makes one of 8 rarer Crests. The X-Antibody augment halves drawbacks.

rules.title: Radiant items
rules.html: Every completed item has a Radiant upgrade: the same item, much stronger. The Radiant Armory lets everyone pick one. The Radiant Blessing comes once per game, at the first free round after you drop to 8 HP or lower: you get 2 gold and a pick of 3 Radiant upgrades (one reroll). Picks upgrade an item you hold, or go to your item bench.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 15 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 4 XP for 4 gold (F), +2 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 5 gold a round (2 early in stage 1). Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 5. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5, 3 gold at 6. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 carousel, 2-5 PvP, 2-6 PvP, 2-7 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, augment 3-2, augment 4-2.

40 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Dragons
rules.html: Dragons take 2 team slots and cost 5 (3-cost), 6 (4-cost) or 7 (5-cost) gold. Each Dragon counts as 3 Digimon for its marked trait (the first trait listed on it). The Dragon trait adds max HP, then armor and magic resist, then damage for 1, 2 and 3 Dragons. Selling a Dragon refunds what you paid. In Normal pace the Dragon trait gives nothing with 3 or more Dragons, and from level 8 a Dragon in your shop is often swapped for another Digimon of the same cost.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 2 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 4 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9. No XP. Income by stage: 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 8 / 9. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, Armory 3-1, augment 3-2, Armory 4-1, augment 4-2, Armory 6-1.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Dragons
rules.html: Dragons take 2 team slots and cost 5 (3-cost), 6 (4-cost) or 7 (5-cost) gold. Each Dragon counts as 3 Digimon for its marked trait (the first trait listed on it). The Dragon trait adds max HP, then armor and magic resist, then damage for 1, 2 and 3 Dragons. Selling a Dragon refunds what you paid. In Normal pace the Dragon trait gives nothing with 3 or more Dragons, and from level 8 a Dragon in your shop is often swapped for another Digimon of the same cost.

rules.html: Round 4-4 is the Treasure Dragon. One version is rolled for the whole lobby: GoldVeedramon (classic), Magnadramon (Order: one bundle is always a Shining item) or Megidramon (Chaos: mystery bundles that can be very good or poor). At 5-1 pick 1 of 4 loot bundles (3 if you lost) with one free reroll.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 15 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 4 XP for 4 gold (F), +2 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 5 gold a round (2 early in stage 1). Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 5. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5, 3 gold at 6. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 carousel, 2-5 PvP, 2-6 PvP, 2-7 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, augment 3-2, augment 4-2.

40 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Into the Arcane
rules.html:
TFT Set 13 Into the Arcane on Digimon, standard pace: 100 Tamer HP, buy XP (4 gold for 4 XP, +2 a round), 5 gold a round plus interest and streak gold, rerolls cost 2. A loss costs stage damage plus damage for each surviving enemy Digimon.

Rounds: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 to 1-4 wild Digimon. From stage 2: x-1 to x-3 PvP, x-4 carousel, x-5 and x-6 PvP, x-7 wild Digimon (artifacts can drop from stage 5). Augments at 2-1, 3-2 and 4-2, the Anomaly at 4-6.

rules.title: Anomalies
rules.html:
Once per game (4-3 in Hyper Roll, 4-6 in standard pace), pick 1 of 3 Anomalies. It goes to the Digimon on your center hex (column 4, second row from the front), or your strongest Digimon if that hex is empty. Rerolls cost 1 gold each (up to 6). The Anomaly stays on that Digimon when it digivolves and is lost if you sell it. A floating label shows it at the start of each combat.

X-Antibody

  • X-Antibody: Power: This Digimon gets 55% more attack damage from every source.
  • X-Antibody: Guard: Gain 15 armor and MR, then 60% more armor and MR from every source.
  • X-Antibody: Mind: Gain 10 AP, then 40% more ability power from every source.
  • X-Antibody: Bulwark: Gain 40 armor and MR, tripled while above 50% HP.
  • X-Antibody: Berserk: Gain 30 AP and 30% AD. Triple it below 50% HP.
  • X-Antibody: Giant: Gain 800 max HP.
  • X-Antibody: Velocity: Gain 10% attack speed. Each cast gives 15% more attack speed for the rest of combat.
  • X-Antibody: Ascension: After 10 seconds of combat, gain 50% max HP and 60% attack speed.

DNA Digivolution

  • DNA Digivolution: Devour: At the start of combat, absorb the nearest ally: it leaves the fight and this Digimon gains 90% of its max HP and attack damage.
  • DNA Digivolution: Share: At the start of combat, adjacent allies gain 12% of this Digimon's attack damage, ability power, max HP, armor and MR.
  • DNA Digivolution: Absorb Power: Gain 30% AD. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its attack damage.
  • DNA Digivolution: Absorb Energy: Gain 30 AP. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its ability power.
  • DNA Digivolution: Nothing Wasted: Start with 20 more mana and gain 15% attack speed. When an ally is knocked out, gain 70% of its mana.
  • DNA Digivolution: Partners: Two Garurumon join the fight beside this Digimon, each with 25% of its max HP and 40% of its attack damage.
  • DNA Digivolution: Spare Body: When knocked out, a ShellNumemon takes its place with this Digimon's max HP, armor and MR.
  • DNA Digivolution: Guardian Link: At the start of combat and every 8 seconds, shields itself and the 2 lowest-health allies for 12% of its max HP.

Digital Hazard

  • Digital Hazard: Fireball: Each cast also throws a fireball (two with 120+ max mana): enemies in the blast take 6% of their max HP as true damage and burn.
  • Digital Hazard: Laser Eyes: Every second, a laser hits enemies in a 3-hex line toward its target for 80% of its ability power as magic damage and burns them.
  • Digital Hazard: Slime Time: Every 2 seconds, deals 110% of its ability power as magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals for the damage dealt.
  • Digital Hazard: Meltdown: Every second, deals 3.5% of its max HP as magic damage to nearby enemies. The radius grows every 6 seconds.
  • Digital Hazard: Finisher: Its attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 18% HP.
  • Digital Hazard: Thousand Cuts: Attacks deal 25 bonus true damage, plus 10 more for each earlier cut on that target (scales with star level).
  • Digital Hazard: Dragon Soul: Its first attack on each new target deals 16% of the target's max HP as true damage.
  • Digital Hazard: Last Chance: The first time it would be knocked out, it returns at full HP with 50% attack speed and 20% omnivamp, but loses 10% max HP every second.
  • Digital Hazard: Thornskin: Gain 60 armor and MR. When damaged, deals 40% of the damage taken to adjacent enemies as magic damage (once a second).

Utility

  • Crest Copy: Gain a Crest for one of this Digimon's traits (the one closest to its next breakpoint). 6 gold if it has none.
  • Dual Wielding: Gain 2 completed items that suit this Digimon.

rules.title: Black Market and Workshop
rules.html:
Kowloon Syndicate: after each player combat with 3 or more Syndicate Digimon you gain Shimmer. Every 100 Shimmer opens the black market at the start of a round: pick one contraband item (tier II from the third market on) or pass to give Syndicate Digimon permanent max HP. Contraband only works on Syndicate Digimon.

Junk King: every 2 rounds (3 in standard pace) while you own Chaosdromon, pick a mech upgrade: Flamethrower, Repairing Microbots, Petricite Rod, Self Destruct Button, Tankbuster, Spare Parts.

rules.title: Portals
rules.html:
One portal opens for the whole lobby at the start of each game:

  • Gold Opener: Every Tamer starts with 6 more gold.
  • Component Anvils: Every Tamer starts with 2 random components.
  • Crest Tag: Every Tamer starts with a Crest Tag.
  • Spare Digivice: Every Tamer starts with a Digivice.
  • Data Copier: Every Tamer starts with a Data Copier.
  • Upgraded Partner: Every Tamer starts with a random 1-cost Digimon in its Champion form.
  • Golden Prelude: The first augment of the game is Gold.
  • Prismatic Finale: The last augment of the game is Prismatic.
  • Free Rolls: Every Tamer gets 2 free rerolls at the start of each stage.
  • No Portal: Nothing special this game.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 2 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 4 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9. No XP. Income by stage: 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 8 / 9. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild. Picks: Armory 2-1, augment 2-2, Armory 3-1, augment 3-2, Armory 4-1, augment 4-2, Armory 5-1, Armory 6-1.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Anomalies
rules.html:
Once per game (4-3 in Hyper Roll, 4-6 in standard pace), pick 1 of 3 Anomalies. It goes to the Digimon on your center hex (column 4, second row from the front), or your strongest Digimon if that hex is empty. Rerolls cost 1 gold each (up to 6). The Anomaly stays on that Digimon when it digivolves and is lost if you sell it. A floating label shows it at the start of each combat.

X-Antibody

  • X-Antibody: Power: This Digimon gets 55% more attack damage from every source.
  • X-Antibody: Guard: Gain 15 armor and MR, then 60% more armor and MR from every source.
  • X-Antibody: Mind: Gain 10 AP, then 40% more ability power from every source.
  • X-Antibody: Bulwark: Gain 40 armor and MR, tripled while above 50% HP.
  • X-Antibody: Berserk: Gain 30 AP and 30% AD. Triple it below 50% HP.
  • X-Antibody: Giant: Gain 800 max HP.
  • X-Antibody: Velocity: Gain 10% attack speed. Each cast gives 15% more attack speed for the rest of combat.
  • X-Antibody: Ascension: After 10 seconds of combat, gain 50% max HP and 60% attack speed.

DNA Digivolution

  • DNA Digivolution: Devour: At the start of combat, absorb the nearest ally: it leaves the fight and this Digimon gains 90% of its max HP and attack damage.
  • DNA Digivolution: Share: At the start of combat, adjacent allies gain 12% of this Digimon's attack damage, ability power, max HP, armor and MR.
  • DNA Digivolution: Absorb Power: Gain 30% AD. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its attack damage.
  • DNA Digivolution: Absorb Energy: Gain 30 AP. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its ability power.
  • DNA Digivolution: Nothing Wasted: Start with 20 more mana and gain 15% attack speed. When an ally is knocked out, gain 70% of its mana.
  • DNA Digivolution: Partners: Two Garurumon join the fight beside this Digimon, each with 25% of its max HP and 40% of its attack damage.
  • DNA Digivolution: Spare Body: When knocked out, a ShellNumemon takes its place with this Digimon's max HP, armor and MR.
  • DNA Digivolution: Guardian Link: At the start of combat and every 8 seconds, shields itself and the 2 lowest-health allies for 12% of its max HP.

Digital Hazard

  • Digital Hazard: Fireball: Each cast also throws a fireball (two with 120+ max mana): enemies in the blast take 6% of their max HP as true damage and burn.
  • Digital Hazard: Laser Eyes: Every second, a laser hits enemies in a 3-hex line toward its target for 80% of its ability power as magic damage and burns them.
  • Digital Hazard: Slime Time: Every 2 seconds, deals 110% of its ability power as magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals for the damage dealt.
  • Digital Hazard: Meltdown: Every second, deals 3.5% of its max HP as magic damage to nearby enemies. The radius grows every 6 seconds.
  • Digital Hazard: Finisher: Its attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 18% HP.
  • Digital Hazard: Thousand Cuts: Attacks deal 25 bonus true damage, plus 10 more for each earlier cut on that target (scales with star level).
  • Digital Hazard: Dragon Soul: Its first attack on each new target deals 16% of the target's max HP as true damage.
  • Digital Hazard: Last Chance: The first time it would be knocked out, it returns at full HP with 50% attack speed and 20% omnivamp, but loses 10% max HP every second.
  • Digital Hazard: Thornskin: Gain 60 armor and MR. When damaged, deals 40% of the damage taken to adjacent enemies as magic damage (once a second).

Utility

  • Crest Copy: Gain a Crest for one of this Digimon's traits (the one closest to its next breakpoint). 6 gold if it has none.
  • Dual Wielding: Gain 2 completed items that suit this Digimon.

rules.title: Black Market and Workshop
rules.html:
Kowloon Syndicate: after each player combat with 3 or more Syndicate Digimon you gain Shimmer. Every 100 Shimmer opens the black market at the start of a round: pick one contraband item (tier II from the third market on) or pass to give Syndicate Digimon permanent max HP. rules.title: Portals
rules.html:
One portal opens for the whole lobby at the start of each game:

  • Gold Opener: Every Tamer starts with 6 more gold.
  • Component Anvils: Every Tamer starts with 2 random components.
  • Crest Tag: Every Tamer starts with a Crest Tag.
  • Spare Digivice: Every Tamer starts with a Digivice.
  • Data Copier: Every Tamer starts with a Data Copier.
  • Upgraded Partner: Every Tamer starts with a random 1-cost Digimon in its Champion form.
  • Golden Prelude: The first augment of the game is Gold.
  • Prismatic Finale: The last augment of the game is Prismatic.
  • Free Rolls: Every Tamer gets 2 free rerolls at the start of each stage.
  • No Portal: Nothing special this game.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 15 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 4 XP for 4 gold (F), +2 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 5 gold a round (2 early in stage 1). Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 5. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5, 3 gold at 6. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 carousel, 2-5 PvP, 2-6 PvP, 2-7 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, augment 3-2, augment 4-2.

40 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Digi-Cores
rules.html:
At the start of rounds 1-3 and 3-6 every Tamer gets a Digi-Core. Drag it onto a Digimon to pick 1 of 3 digivolution paths for it. Attack carries, casters and front liners get different choices. The path stays when the Digimon digivolves. A new Digi-Core replaces the old path. Selling the Digimon, or a Data Extractor, gives the Digi-Core back.

  • Burst Mode: Deals 12% more damage, 25% more after its first takedown each combat.
  • X-Antibody: When hit, gains 4 armor (physical) or 8 MR (magic), up to 90 in total.
  • Dark Digivolution: Gains 22% attack damage and 10% omnivamp, but loses 1% max HP every second.
  • Warp Digivolution: Gains 8% attack damage, 8 AP, 10 armor and MR, and deals 5% more damage.
  • Armor Digivolution: Starts combat with a 25% max HP shield. While shielded, gains 30% attack speed.
  • Mode Change: At the start of combat, it and its nearest ally gain an 18% max HP shield.
  • Slide Evolution: When it switches targets, its next attack deals 120% bonus damage as magic damage.
  • Spirit Evolution: The first time it drops below 40% HP, heals 25% max HP and gains 25% attack speed.
  • Death-X Evolution: Leaps to the enemy backline at the start of combat and gains 30% crit chance and 10% crit damage.
  • Biomerge: Gains 3% attack damage and 3 AP every second, up to 30 times.
  • Mega Digivolution: Gains 40% attack damage.
  • Sage Evolution: Gains 25 AP.
  • Golem Form: Gains 30% max HP.
  • Speed Form: Gains 30% attack speed.
  • Overwrite: Gains 30% crit chance and 15% crit damage; its abilities can critically strike.
  • Matrix Evolution: Its max mana is 25% lower and it starts combat with 10 extra mana.
  • Overdrive: Deals 12% more damage. After its first takedown or 10 seconds of combat, stuns enemies within 2 hexes for 1.5 seconds and deals 20% more damage for the rest of combat.
  • Atomic Core: Stores 10% max HP at the start of combat and 2% more every second. When it falls, deals the stored amount as magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes.
  • Thorn Armor: When attacked, deals 50 + 5% of its max HP as magic damage to adjacent enemies (1 second cooldown).
  • Glacier Mode: Gains 15% attack speed. Attacks slow the target's attack speed by 30% for 2 seconds.
  • Inferno Mode: Its abilities burn their targets, and it deals 15% more damage to burning enemies.
  • Hunter Mode: Deals 8% more damage, and 30% more to enemies below 50% HP.
  • Guardian Mode: Gains 30 armor and MR. Adjacent allies gain 10 armor and MR.
  • Ascension: After 6 seconds of combat, deals 40% more damage.

rules.title: Stances and partners
rules.html:
When you get Justimon or Labramon you pick its form. Until you pick, it fights with the first one.

  • Blitz Arm: Duelist stance. Gains the Duelist trait and 30% attack speed. Its ability strikes the 2 nearest enemies several times and cuts their armor.
  • Critical Arm: Executioner stance. Gains the Executioner trait and 20% crit chance. Its ability hits the lowest-health enemy within 3 hexes, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and splashes adjacent enemies.
  • Trinity Arm: Juggernaut stance. Gains the Juggernaut trait and 400 HP. Its ability takes 50% less damage for 2 seconds, then smashes its target and everything around it.
  • Ballistamon: Tank partner. 20% more HP and 15 armor and MR. Its ability gains a shield, taunts nearby enemies and stuns them briefly.
  • Dorulumon: Diver partner. 30% more attack damage and 20% omnivamp. Its ability drills through to the lowest-health enemy, double damage below 50% HP.
  • Sparrowmon: Ranged partner. Attacks from 4 hexes with 25% more attack speed. Its ability gives it 50% attack speed for 5 seconds and fires at 3 enemies.

rules.title: Jewel Gambit
rules.html:
Jewel Gambit Digimon gain max HP and deal more damage. Kills and losses in player combats earn Gem Power. Every 3 player combats, cash the gems out for gold and items, or Double Down: losses then earn twice as much, but a win halves your Gem Power and cashes out at once.

Gem Power per kill: 1 in stages 1-2, 1.5 in stage 3, 2 from stage 4. Per loss: 4, 6, 8. Cash-out: 50% of Gem Power as gold, a component at 25, a completed item at 45, two at 80.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 2 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 4 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9. No XP. Income by stage: 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 8 / 9. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 carousel, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild. Picks: Armory 2-1, augment 2-2, Armory 3-1, augment 3-2, Armory 4-1, augment 4-2, Armory 5-1, Armory 6-1.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Digi-Cores
rules.html:
At the start of rounds 1-3 and 3-3 every Tamer gets a Digi-Core. Drag it onto a Digimon to pick 1 of 3 digivolution paths for it. Attack carries, casters and front liners get different choices. The path stays when the Digimon digivolves. A new Digi-Core replaces the old path. Selling the Digimon, or a Data Extractor, gives the Digi-Core back.

  • Burst Mode: Deals 12% more damage, 25% more after its first takedown each combat.
  • X-Antibody: When hit, gains 4 armor (physical) or 8 MR (magic), up to 90 in total.
  • Dark Digivolution: Gains 22% attack damage and 10% omnivamp, but loses 1% max HP every second.
  • Warp Digivolution: Gains 8% attack damage, 8 AP, 10 armor and MR, and deals 5% more damage.
  • Armor Digivolution: Starts combat with a 25% max HP shield. While shielded, gains 30% attack speed.
  • Mode Change: At the start of combat, it and its nearest ally gain an 18% max HP shield.
  • Slide Evolution: When it switches targets, its next attack deals 120% bonus damage as magic damage.
  • Spirit Evolution: The first time it drops below 40% HP, heals 25% max HP and gains 25% attack speed.
  • Death-X Evolution: Leaps to the enemy backline at the start of combat and gains 30% crit chance and 10% crit damage.
  • Biomerge: Gains 3% attack damage and 3 AP every second, up to 30 times.
  • Mega Digivolution: Gains 40% attack damage.
  • Sage Evolution: Gains 25 AP.
  • Golem Form: Gains 30% max HP.
  • Speed Form: Gains 30% attack speed.
  • Overwrite: Gains 30% crit chance and 15% crit damage; its abilities can critically strike.
  • Matrix Evolution: Its max mana is 25% lower and it starts combat with 10 extra mana.
  • Overdrive: Deals 12% more damage. After its first takedown or 10 seconds of combat, stuns enemies within 2 hexes for 1.5 seconds and deals 20% more damage for the rest of combat.
  • Atomic Core: Stores 10% max HP at the start of combat and 2% more every second. When it falls, deals the stored amount as magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes.
  • Thorn Armor: When attacked, deals 50 + 5% of its max HP as magic damage to adjacent enemies (1 second cooldown).
  • Glacier Mode: Gains 15% attack speed. Attacks slow the target's attack speed by 30% for 2 seconds.
  • Inferno Mode: Its abilities burn their targets, and it deals 15% more damage to burning enemies.
  • Hunter Mode: Deals 8% more damage, and 30% more to enemies below 50% HP.
  • Guardian Mode: Gains 30 armor and MR. Adjacent allies gain 10 armor and MR.
  • Ascension: After 6 seconds of combat, deals 40% more damage.

rules.title: Stances and partners
rules.html:
When you get Justimon or Labramon you pick its form. Until you pick, it fights with the first one.

  • Blitz Arm: Duelist stance. Gains the Duelist trait and 30% attack speed. Its ability strikes the 2 nearest enemies several times and cuts their armor.
  • Critical Arm: Executioner stance. Gains the Executioner trait and 20% crit chance. Its ability hits the lowest-health enemy within 3 hexes, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and splashes adjacent enemies.
  • Trinity Arm: Juggernaut stance. Gains the Juggernaut trait and 400 HP. Its ability takes 50% less damage for 2 seconds, then smashes its target and everything around it.
  • Ballistamon: Tank partner. 20% more HP and 15 armor and MR. Its ability gains a shield, taunts nearby enemies and stuns them briefly.
  • Dorulumon: Diver partner. 30% more attack damage and 20% omnivamp. Its ability drills through to the lowest-health enemy, double damage below 50% HP.
  • Sparrowmon: Ranged partner. Attacks from 4 hexes with 25% more attack speed. Its ability gives it 50% attack speed for 5 seconds and fires at 3 enemies.

rules.title: Jewel Gambit
rules.html:
Jewel Gambit Digimon gain max HP and deal more damage. Kills and losses in player combats earn Gem Power. Every 3 player combats, cash the gems out for gold and items, or Double Down: losses then earn twice as much, but a win halves your Gem Power and cashes out at once.

Gem Power per kill: 1 in stages 1-2, 1.5 in stage 3, 2 from stage 4. Per loss: 4, 6, 8. Cash-out: 50% of Gem Power as gold, a component at 25, a completed item at 45, two at 80.

rules.title: Rounds
rules.html: Hyper Roll rules: 20 Tamer HP, levels set by the stage, fixed income (3/5/6/7/8 by stage), 2 gold per player win, rerolls cost 1. Stage 1: opening carousel, then two wild rounds. Later stages: three player rounds and a wild round at x-4, where the tournament bracket sends a stronger champion each time (Kimeramon, then Darkdramon, then the Royal Knights). Armory at x-1 of stages 2-6, augments at 2-2, 3-2 and 4-2.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 0 / 1 / 1 / 2 / 2 / 3 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 5 XP for 5 gold (F), +1 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 5 gold a round. Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 3. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5, 3 gold at 7, 4 gold at 8. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 wild, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 PvP, 1-5 PvP. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 PvP, 2-5 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, augment 4-2.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.html: Each stage has 5 rounds, so round 10 is 2-5 and round 30 is 6-5. Rounds 1, 2, 3 and every 5th round from 10 are creep rounds; the rest are fights against players.

rules.title: Economy
rules.html: 5 gold per round, 1 gold per player win, 1 interest per 10 gold (up to 3), streak gold for 3+ wins or losses (losses up to 2). Rerolls cost 2. 5 gold buys 5 XP; you also get 1 XP per round. You start at level 3 with 5 gold and 100 HP.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 3 / 3 / 4 / 4 / 5 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 / 10 / 10 / 10. No XP. Income by stage: 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 / 10 / 10 / 10 / 10 / 10. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 wild, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 PvP, 1-5 PvP. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 PvP, 2-5 wild.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

100 Tamer HP. A loss costs 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 HP in stages 2-7 plus damage for each enemy Digimon still standing (1, 1 or 2 by form).

Levels: buy 4 XP for 5 gold (F), +1 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 5 gold a round. Interest: 1 per 10 gold saved, up to 5. Win or loss streaks: 1 gold at 3, 2 gold at 5, 3 gold at 7. A PvP win pays 1. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 wild, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild, 1-4 PvP, 1-5 PvP. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 PvP, 2-5 wild. Picks: augment 2-1, augment 4-2.

35 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 35 s; a fight still going at 50 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Rounds
rules.html: Five rounds a stage. Creep rounds: 1, 2, 3 and every fifth round from 10 (2-5, 3-5, ...). Win a creep round: pick 1 of 3 items next round. Lose it: one random item. Relics: pick 1 of 3 at 3-2, 5-2 and 7-2; a new relic replaces the old one.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

20 Tamer HP. A loss costs 2 / 2 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 4 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels by stage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10. No XP. Income by stage: 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 8 / 9. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 2. Rerolls cost 1.

Stage 1: 1-1 wild, 1-2 wild, 1-3 wild. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP, 2-3 PvP, 2-4 wild.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Pace: Normal
rules.html:
Normal. Standard rules: buy XP, save for interest, longer games. Choose Hyper Roll on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Pace: Hyper Roll
rules.html:
Hyper Roll. Short games: levels come with each stage, fixed income, cheap rerolls. Choose Normal on the Play page or in the lobby for the other pace.

4 Tamer HP. A loss costs 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 HP in stages 2-7.

Levels: buy 4 XP for 999 gold (F), +1 XP each round, up to level 10. Income: 6 gold a round. No interest. No streak gold. A PvP win pays 0. Rerolls cost 2.

Stage 1: 1-1 PvP, 1-2 PvP. Stage 2: 2-1 PvP, 2-2 PvP.

30 s planning. Combat overtime starts at 30 s; a fight still going at 45 s is a draw.

rules.title: Duos: teams of two
rules.html:
Choose Duos alongside your set and pace. Eight Tamers form four teams. Partners share health and finish together, from first to fourth, while keeping their own shops, gold, items and boards.

During planning, drag a bench Digimon or item onto the Partner Portal. Hyper Roll allows one send per round; Normal allows two. Sent copies can complete your partner’s digivolution. A full bench accepts a Digimon only if it can digivolve immediately.

Both partners fight together on a wide arena against the other team. Traits count across both boards and apply to your whole side. Your augments and items still belong to you. Eleven Duos augments reward teamwork. Wild Digimon rounds and carousels stay individual.

Click your partner’s panel to view their board. In multiplayer, adjacent lobby seats with the same team number are partners; move to an empty seat to change teams. When a team is eliminated, both partners see the final attacker’s ultimate and the winning team’s victory dance.

rules.title: Knockout
rules.html: 4 lives: each lost round costs one. Two copies digivolve. You start at level 5 and level up every 2 rounds (XP cannot be bought). Pick a starter crew of 5 at 1-1 and a Tamer at 1-2; the Tamer ranks up every 2 rounds. An item pick every other round. Base gold starts at 6 and rises each round; no interest or streak gold. Each stage has 2 rounds.
